title: Maternal-fetal Outcomes of Genital Blood Loss Beyond 18 Weeks of Pregnancy
official: Maternal-fetal Outcomes of Genital Blood Loss Beyond 18 Weeks of Pregnancy
summary: The primary objective is to assess in terms of frequency the adverse outcomes (premature birth, maternal-fetal haemorrhage, maternal fetal-neonatal death) of pregnancies of women attending the obstetric-gynaecological emergency department for genital bleeding beyond the 18th week of pregnancy.
